name: Trip and home cost
summary: Fuel and trip cost, electricity cost of appliances
author: friday-core
description: Everyday running costs worked out exactly. It holds 2 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Trip cost: Fuel needed and its price for a distance, tolls, and the share per traveller. Electricity cost: Units (kWh) and rupees for an appliance by rating or typical wattage.
